title: TimelineResponse
description:
`GET /v1/sandboxes/{id}/customers/{cid}/timeline`: the customer's events in business-time
order. While a rebuild runs the timeline is partial; `GET .../crm/rebuild` says so.

label.description: A short fixed sentence with the event's own figures, such as `Paid $22.00`.

ref.description: The ULID of the order, catering event, message or customer the line is about.

type.description: The event's catalog name, such as `OrderPaid`.
